title: How far a class has travelled

steps.say: **Course journey** is where the class has got to, measured in LEGOs — the individual pieces of language the course teaches. The bar is how much of the course it has covered together.
The line underneath gives both figures: the class's own shared position, and the average its students have reached learning alone. It then names the next belt and how many LEGOs are left to reach it.
A class that has never played together has no shared position at all, so the bar falls back to the students' average and says as much.
steps.terminal: That's the distance travelled, class first and students alongside. This tour changed nothing; only your own taps do.
